name: Multi-LogiEval
description: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to exhibit remarkable performance in natural language understanding tasks, there is a crucial need to measure their ability for human-like multi-step logical reasoning. Existing logical reasoning evaluation benchmarks often focus primarily on simplistic single-step or multi-step reasoning with a limited set of inference rules. Furthermore, the lack of datasets for evaluating non-monotonic reasoning represents a crucial gap since it aligns more closely with human-like reasoning.
reputation: A recent logical reasoning benchmark that has seen some attention in LLM evaluation work, but is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Likely relatively small and specialized; includes non-monotonic reasoning, so scores may vary substantially by model prompting and setup.
